decisions.reason: The award win signals results above aspiration, and the product sits close to the core yogurt business, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.
The firm features it on the home page as a flagship of its direction, which shows commitment and satisfactory early reception within a growing industry.
A semi-hard cheese wheel close to the established offer costs little to carry in a growing market, and there is no evidence of a shortfall.
This multi-variant line builds on the core, and while weaker variants might be pruned, the line overall shows no sign of falling below aspiration.
It was presented as rounding off the new cheese range, and with industry turnover growing, the firm has slack to give it time despite uncertain results.
Washed-rind soft cheese is a more niche product with uncertain uptake, but with no reported shortfall and growth giving slack, the firm is likely to keep it for now.
